cases.name: negotiate-known-v0-profile
steps: alice advertises v0 with accepted profile hash and optional v1
bob ignores unknown v1, verifies v0 profile hash, and selects v0
both peers bind advertised alternatives and final selection into the session transcript

cases.name: reject-profile-hash-mismatch
steps: peer advertises branch/connectivity/0 with an unaccepted profile multihash
receiver rejects before accepting sealed payloads, route candidates, relay capabilities, or frames

cases.name: reject-required-capability
steps: peer advertises an unknown required capability
receiver ignores optional unknown capabilities but rejects unknown required capabilities

cases.name: same-relay-wss-online-delivery
steps: alice obtains a validated BootstrapBeacon and passes only relay identity, accepted profile, capabilities, expiry and ordered WSS endpoints to transport
alice opens WSS /relay/v0 and sends HELLO with accepted profile hash, fresh client nonce and relay.forward.live/0
relay replies CHALLENGE with fresh relay nonce, selected offer, transcript_hash and Ed25519 relay_proof from the beacon sender key
alice verifies relay key proof and sends AUTH binding both nonces and the selected transcript
relay replies READY with memory-only session_id, route_id, heartbeat interval, presence TTL and bounded accepted_limits
alice and bob both publish PRESENCE and renew it with HEARTBEAT while attached
alice LOOKUP and RENDEZVOUS resolve only bob's currently live route
alice sends one opaque ENVELOPE and relay forwards it only because bob is currently attached
relay sends ACK relay.forwarded with durable false and never claims mailbox custody

cases.name: relay-attach-missing-capability
steps: client opens a relay WSS attachment with accepted version and profile
client omits receiver-issued live forwarding capability
relay rejects without creating durable route, mailbox, message, or presence state

cases.name: relay-envelope-peer-unavailable
steps: alice has an authenticated READY relay session and sends ENVELOPE for bob's route
bob is disconnected, expired or not currently reachable under local policy
relay returns ERROR peer_unavailable with retryable true
relay does not persist the ENVELOPE, does not create a you-were-called event, and does not replay after bob reconnects
alice owns any pending retry state locally

cases.name: delivery-dedup-overlap
steps: session has old relay path and new direct path in overlap
sender retransmits one encrypted delivery with the same delivery_id on both paths
receiver accepts the first authenticated frame and treats the second as an idempotent duplicate

cases.name: path-migration-active-to-retire
steps: active path carries current path_epoch
peer proposes higher epoch and enters probing
old and new paths overlap while delivery_id deduplication remains active
both peers commit the new epoch
old path is retired without changing peer identity or session state

cases.name: relay-restart-restores-no-user-traffic
steps: relay forwards opaque encrypted frames for live attached peers
relay restarts
relay keeps only node identity, operator configuration, and transport material
relay restores no user messages, files, delivery queues, session routes, contact state, or canonical presence
